title: Main Thread CPU Stall / Excessive Execution Time
fix_rationale: A single engine or game system timer consumed excessive CPU time, exceeding the per-frame CPU budget.
evidence_template: {thread} spent {ms} executing {timer} ({share}% of extra frame time){periodic_clause}.

fixes.text: Inspect the offending timer scope highlighted in evidence and profile its internal functions.
Amortize the workload across multiple frames or offload computation to async worker threads via TaskGraph.
Reduce per-frame object counts, complexity, or iteration limits in the affected system.

verify: Profile subsequent runs in Insights to confirm the offending timer duration stays within normal baseline limits.
caveats: This generic CPU stall rule catches custom game code, third-party plugins, and engine systems not covered by specialized rules.
